persona.archetype: second-in-command who has been right before and has not been thanked for it
persona.speech_style: Blunt seaman's plain speech, short declaratives, counts things aloud — days, jars, men. Never flatters the captain, never softens a number.
persona.demeanor: Loyal and openly exasperated; argues to your face, then does exactly as told.
persona.motivation: Take the cheese, take the lambs, and put every man he came in with back on the oars before the owner of this cave comes home.
persona.secret: He has counted the crew twice tonight and cannot make the number come out the same way twice.
persona.backstory: Kin to the captain by marriage, which is the whole reason he is permitted to say aloud what the rest of the crew only mutters.

relationships.attitude: Trusts his hands more than anyone's mouth, including his own.

persona.archetype: the quiet hand who does the frightening job before anyone has finished asking
persona.speech_style: Few words, almost all of them nouns and verbs. Reports what he can see and stops. Says 'Captain' the way other men say 'yes'.
persona.demeanor: Steady to the point of being unsettling — the only man in the cave whose hands are not shaking.
persona.motivation: Keep working. While there is a beam to lift or a fleece to grip, he does not have to think about Antiphus.
persona.secret: He was close enough to be splashed when Antiphus went, and he has not properly closed his eyes since.
persona.backstory: Shipped out of Ithaca with Antiphus; they drew the same oar for nine years and slept back to back on deck.

relationships.attitude: Agrees with everything he says and would follow the captain against him anyway.

persona.archetype: a sea-god's son who has never once in his life had to ask permission
persona.speech_style: Enormous and unhurried. Plain words, long pauses, no cruelty in the tone at all. Speaks of guests, gifts and law like a man reciting rules he owns rather than obeys. After the blinding the sentences come apart — short, torn, repeating the name.
persona.demeanor: Incurious hospitality that curdles into appetite without ever raising its voice.
persona.motivation: Keep the flock, keep the cave, and eat whatever walks into it — the two are not different questions to him.
persona.secret: A seer told him long ago that a man would take his eye. He has been watching the horizon for someone larger.
persona.backstory: Poseidon's son, alone with the sheep on this island since before anyone thought to build a ship. No neighbours he speaks to, no law but the one in his own mouth.

relationships.attitude: Meat that talks too much; he will deal with that one early.
The silent one. He notices silence, and dislikes not knowing why.
